What is this job about?
ASG Platform is looking for a Full Stack Developer Intern to assist our demanding customer website infrastructure and our Full Stack Developers. Our projects require implementing our pre-approved UI, constructing our API, connecting the two, and setting up our server infrastructure with our client's current systems.

The main functions are as follows:
- Help the Full Stack Developers to build the core and support systems for a communication platform.
- Help maintenance of the core and support systems by constantly updating the source codes and allied repositories.
- Assist the Full Stack Developers with technical documentation and maintain active tech repositories for all tech activities carried out.

Job Location and Compensation
- This job is a remote position. You can work anywhere in the Philippines.
- Your working shift will be 7 AM - 5 PM Central Standard Time in the USA with a one-hour break. (8 PM - 6 AM Philippine time)
- Applicants can expect a salary of PHP 20,000 - PHP 25,000 per month

Benefits

Work from home set up

Health care insurance

Paid training provided
Full-time job
Bonuses

PTO

What do you need to qualify?

  • Bachelor’s/College Degree, Computer Science or equivalent.
    - At least 1 year experience in Writing HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Being up on the latest practices is a must, e.g., HTML5, CSS3, and ECMAScript 6 (minimum).
    - At least 1 year of experience with a relevant back-end programming language (i.e. PHP, Python, Ruby, or JavaScript).
    - Knowledgeable database design and management, including being up on the latest practices and associated versions.
    - It will be important that you like working in a team, as team collaboration is necessary for all of our positions.
    - Requires great internet with a backup source in case your primary internet source is interrupted for any reason.

    ‼️ Job opening exclusive only to Filipino locals ‼️

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

The ASG Platform helps organize business processes by enabling the development of a personal connection and a lasting relationship with customers, partners, and other elements of the chain such as the suppliers and investors. We offer a modern tool for communication empowering businesses to connect with their employees and customers wherever they are, using their existing phone lines that have been upgraded into a smart one in order to convey the right message at the right time to the right people.

We help business processes, like enabling the development of connection and a lasting relationship between business and their customers. We offer a modern tool for communication.
